title: WorkspaceStandards
description: Structured developer specifications for automated repository generation and AI agent constraint enforcement.

github_flow.on_completion: open PR against main, following pr_template

turbo_generator_mappings.description: Direct mapping coordinates for turbo gen inputs matching this schema.

versioning_and_releases.versioning_strategy: The source of truth is the git commit SHA. Downstream repos adopt the commit SHA of dotfiles. Bump version in manifest.json for normative changes.
versioning_and_releases.changelog_policy: Any normative changes under guides/, validation/, or scripts/ must update the root CHANGELOG.md in the same commit.

monorepo_orchestration.task_management: Root scripts delegate to Turborepo. Tasks like test, lint, format, and typecheck must be consistent across packages.
monorepo_orchestration.task_dependencies: test, lint, format tasks depend on ^build to ensure upstream dependencies are built first. Missing build scripts in pure-source packages are skipped.
monorepo_orchestration.polyglot_integration: Python packages plug into Turborepo via package.json scripts that run uv commands. Cache invalidation paths include pyproject.toml, uv.lock, *.py, ruff.toml, and pyrightconfig.json.

typescript_platform_baseline.module_system: Fully ESM with type: module, NodeNext module resolution, and mandatory .ts extension in relative imports. Use node: protocol imports for built-ins.
typescript_platform_baseline.compiler_settings: Strict mode is enabled (strictNullChecks, noImplicitAny, etc.). Build configurations extend packages/tsconfig/base.json.
typescript_platform_baseline.formatting_and_linting: ESLint Flat Config (eslint.config.js) using @eslint/js, typescript-eslint, eslint-plugin-import, eslint-plugin-n, and eslint-config-prettier. Prettier handles formatting (.prettierrc: semi: true, singleQuote: true, trailingComma: all, printWidth: 100, tabWidth: 2).
typescript_platform_baseline.export_rules: Named exports are required. Default exports are only used if required by external API contracts. Exported functions must declare explicit return types.
typescript_platform_baseline.type_location_rules: Three-tier model: Domain types live in @battleship/types; package-scoped types live in src/types.ts extending domain types; implementation-private types are declared inline.

node_server_conventions.app_assembly: app.ts creates and exports the Express application. index.ts imports and calls .listen(). This separates port binding from initialization to allow test importing.
node_server_conventions.routing_pattern: One *Router.ts file per domain, mounted in app.ts under a path prefix.
node_server_conventions.controllers_pattern: Controllers are factory functions returning an object of handler methods.
node_server_conventions.middleware_rules: bodyParser.json() applied per-router, not globally. cors() applied globally. Request logging applied globally. errorHandler registered last.
node_server_conventions.logging_standard: Structured JSON logs using Pino via a thin wrapper in @battleship/util. No console.log in application code. local development piped through pino-pretty.
node_server_conventions.error_handling: No try/catch in route handlers. Express 5 auto-forwards thrown errors to errorHandler middleware. Custom error classes in @battleship/types extend AppError and carry a statusCode.

python_platform_baseline.package_management: uv is the standard manager. Commit uv.lock and use frozen sync in CI. requires-python >=3.13,<3.14.
python_platform_baseline.type_safety: Pyright in strict mode. Explicit return types on exported/public functions and methods.
python_platform_baseline.boundary_validation: Use Pydantic v2 models for all inter-system boundaries. Parse, don't cast. Settings and environment use pydantic-settings.
python_platform_baseline.linting_formatting: Ruff is the only formatter and primary linter. Configurations are shared at the root.
python_platform_baseline.api_wire_contract: Committed OpenAPI document (YAML or JSON) is the single source of truth. FastAPI app app.openapi() output is drift-checked in CI. Downstream packages codegen from this spec.

python_server_conventions.app_assembly: Application factory or module-level app that returns an importable ASGI app separate from Uvicorn startup.
python_server_conventions.routing_pattern: One APIRouter per domain, mounted under path prefixes.
python_server_conventions.controllers_pattern: Thin route handlers parsing/validating input, calling a services/ layer, and mapping results. Heavy logic in services/. FastAPI Depends for DI.
python_server_conventions.middleware_rules: CORS, request/correlation ID, and body size limits applied deliberately.
python_server_conventions.logging_standard: Structured JSON logs using structlog or standard logging with JSON formatter. Log correlation fields (requestId, gameId) aligned with Node services.
python_server_conventions.error_handling: Single exception handler mapping exceptions to HTTP status codes and stable JSON error bodies. Operational vs unexpected error distinction.
python_server_conventions.database_integration: SQLAlchemy 2.x with Alembic migrations. Postgres in production; SQLite in test. Setup/teardown runs migrations before tests and destroys connections after.

client_react_typescript.testing_framework: React Testing Library (RTL) for component testing from user perspective; MSW 2.x for API mocking at network layer.
client_react_typescript.component_conventions: Functional components only. Arrow function syntax with destructured props. No React.FC. Explicit React.JSX.Element return type. App.tsx must stay thin.
client_react_typescript.prop_typing: Name prop interfaces with a Props suffix.
client_react_typescript.hook_colocation: Co-locate hooks with the components that own them (e.g. src/game/useGameState.ts with src/game/GameBoard.tsx). Only promote to shared hooks/ if used by multiple features.
client_react_typescript.styling_system: Tailwind CSS is the sole styling system. CSS variables in HSL format define theme tokens to support dark/light modes. No styled-components or CSS modules.
client_react_typescript.primitive_components: shadcn/ui is the standard library. Primitives are copied as source files into src/components/ui/ and normalized (cn helper, import paths).
client_react_typescript.styling_utilities: clsx, tailwind-merge, and class-variance-authority combined into a single cn() helper. CVA is used for variant-driven leaf/atomic components. Components must accept external className overrides.
client_react_typescript.global_stylesheets: index.css is restricted to CSS reset, font-face declarations, Tailwind @layer base directives, and CSS custom properties Tailwind cannot express.
client_react_typescript.state_management_hierarchy: Local state (useState) is the default. Server state is managed solely by TanStack Query (no useEffect for API data fetching; use useMutation with invalidation). Shared client state uses small, domain-scoped Zustand stores with selector-based subscriptions.

validation_and_quality.accessibility_bar: Target WCAG 2.2 AA for internal tools. Enforce eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y and runtime checks (@axe-core/playwright) on built previews in CI. Focus/keyboard order must match visual layout.
validation_and_quality.privacy_and_security: No real secrets, passwords, or host credentials in git. Use fake values in docs (e.g. sk-test-..., REDACTED, ****). Gitleaks is enforced in CI. Optional local private notes folder gitignored.
validation_and_quality.branch_standards: Default branch is main. Topic branch prefixes: feature/, fix/, chore/, docs/ followed by a kebab-case slug. Enforced by validate workflow in CI.

python_domain_stubs.python_ai_agents: CrewAI / LangGraph with Pydantic models for tool/graph inputs and outputs, observability field alignment, and mock fixtures.
python_domain_stubs.python_cli_tools: Typer with Pydantic CLI payloads, help/UX consistency, and distribution via uv scripts.
python_domain_stubs.python_etl_data: Polars lazy/eager strategy, Pydantic validation at pipeline boundaries, and testing with golden files.
